Overview

Fremdenzimmer Fam Schwendinger is a small, family-run guest accommodation in Sankt Anton am Arlberg in the Tyrolean district of Landeck. In business directories the establishment is classified under the categories of guesthouse and “guest rooms”; some listings also describe it as a family guesthouse or under rural accommodation. The address is Alte Arlbergstraße 9, 6580 Sankt Anton am Arlberg. Unlike an inn with a public restaurant, the focus here is on renting out guest rooms. The house is located in the Arlberg mountain world, in one of Austria’s best-known ski resorts. The name suffix “Fam” refers to a family business; in the directories Angelika Schwendinger is listed at the same address.

Getting there

Sankt Anton am Arlberg is connected to the rail network via the Arlbergbahn railway with its own station and can be reached by car via the Arlberg Schnellstraße (S16). The Alte Arlbergstraße lies within the village; the exact location and access should be arranged directly with the accommodation before arrival. Tips

As this is a small private guesthouse and no website of its own is given in the sources, it is advisable to clarify availability, facilities and arrival by telephone in advance. For your stay, the St. Anton am Arlberg region offers an extensive range of leisure activities. The Ski Arlberg ski area, with over 300 kilometres of pistes, is considered the largest in Austria; in addition there are cross-country ski trails and facilities such as the Arlberg WellCom adventure pool and the arl.rock sports and leisure centre. Hikers and winter sports enthusiasts will find a dense network of trails and pistes around the village.

Best travel time

St. Anton am Arlberg is a year-round destination with two distinct seasons: the winter season from around December to April is dedicated to skiing and snowboarding, while the summer months from June to September invite you to hike and climb.
